tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (189)drang srong skyo glu nyes pa'i mtshangs 'don mgon po bskul 'debs spro dga' bskyed cing gros su gdams pa bzhugs/(190)bde chen 'pho 'gyur med
(189)drang srong skyo glu nyes pa'i mtshangs 'don mgon po bskul 'debs spro dga' bskyed cing gros su gdams pa bzhugs/(190)bde chen 'pho 'gyur med

tei:div.tei:p: (189)drang srong skyo glu nyes pa'i mtshangs 'don mgon po bskul 'debs spro dga' bskyed cing gros su gdams pa bzhugs/ (190)bde chen 'pho 'gyur med pa zung 'jug gi ye shes/ rtogs dgom mtha' ru phyin nas nang dbyings su gzim pa'i/ stong gsal chos sku'i bla ma stong gzugs su ma bzhugs/ gang 'dul gzugs sku'i bkod pas 'gro don la bzhengs shog sems nyid rig stong sku gsum rang chas su bzhugs kyang*/ rang ngo ma shes kun rtog 'khrul snang la 'byams pas/ kun 'byung las nyon dbang gis rigs drug gi duḥkhar/ rtag tu 'khyams pa'i sgyu ma'i 'gro khams la dgongs shig srid zhi'i bde skyid 'byung gnas bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa/ 'gro ba'i re ltos (191)skyabs gnas sngon byon gyi dam pa/ bstan dang bstan 'jin tshogs rnams mi mngon dbyings gshegs pas/ dus mthar sakayes pa'i bu nga dbang med du skyo byung*/ sdug bsngal sems kyi tshor bas snying rlung de bskyed nas/ smre ngag gdung ba'i nga ros brgyud gsum gyi bla ma/ thugs dam gnad nas bskul na skyo grogs la phebs shog bu'i nga'i sems kyi skyo ba sangs grogs zhig mjod pa/ mar la bltas pas ma rgan 'gro drug la sems na/ don med las kyi dub bzhin skye rga dang na 'chi'i/ sdug bsngal brgyud mas mnar (192)bzhin las nyon gyi gzhan dbang*/ med snang stong gzugs 'khyams la snying rje zhig skyes mdo/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i gdol spyod 'chol ba yi rkyen gyis/ ya rab tshugs bral nyes spyod mtha' dag la g.yeng bzhin/ mi dgos bskyed pa'i nad mug 'khrug rtsod la rtag tu/ g.yeng ba'i las ngan dus mtha'i skye bo rnams sha tsha/ yar la bltas pas nyams thag 'gro ba yi skyabs yul/ dam tshig smin grol rtogs goms yon tan dang bral bzhin/ dad gshin re ltos 'cha' ba'i nor rdzas la g.yengs shing*/ 'di phyi gnyis la rang gzhan brlag pa 'dis skyo byung*/

'byung pos brlab pa'i mngon shes na bun la mchog 'jin/ bskyed rdzogs med pa'i sngags chog cho ga yi gzugs brnyan/ dag dran med pa'i gdangs dbyangs rnga rol la bskyon nas/ blun po dga' ba'i tshul (193)'chos bla mchod 'dis skyo byung*/ phan btags drin gyis bskyang ba'i pha ma yi sems can/ 'tsho ba'i srog la rgol nas sha khrag gi dmar mchod/ thugs rje mnga' ba'i mchog gsum dgyes pa zhig 'dod pa'i/ bon dang phyi rol gyur pa'i chos lugs 'dis skyo byung*/ sngon byon dam pas thub bstan lung rtogs kyi chos la/ bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis ldan 'jin skyong rang mjad bzhin/ rang rgyud smin cing grol nas skal bzang gi gdul bya/ thar lam bkod pa'i rnam thar bsam gyin rang skyo byung*/ deng sang bstan 'jin rlom pa'i mjad spyod la brtags na/ thub bstan bshad sgrub gnyis la ltas ngan bzhin 'jem shing*/ chags sdang dregs pas khengs shing tha mal gyi skye bo'i/ 'du 'ji'i g.yengs la bstan 'jin yin (194)snyam 'dis skyo byung*/ skyabs kyi mchog gyur 'jig rten drags pa nyid bzung nas/ yi dam snying po bsang dang gsol mchod la brtson zhing*/ 'dun ma khe dregs rnyed bstod grags snyan sogs 'di snang*/ phrinal sa bsam sbyor ngan pa'i srung zlog 'dis skyo byung*/ sngon 'gro'i chos la gshar 'don lung tsam zhig zhus nas/ dngos gzhi smin grol lam la thos bsam dang sgom pa/ go myong rtogs gsum bral yang yon tan can rloms nas/ za 'dod rnyed tshol rngam pa'i bla gzugs 'dis skyo byung*/ tha mal skye bo thar lam blal ma yis bkod na/ deng sang bla mas skye bo mi dge bar bskul 'debs/ g.yo sgyu rku rdzun dmag jag thams cad kyi mgo dpon/ bstan pa'i bla btsong dkon mchog rkang 'dren 'dis skyo byung*/ sngon byon dam pa'i yang srid sprul (195)sku zhes sgro btags/ lang 'dug thub nas za chog tshong dpon du chas shing*/

mdo sngags zab rgyas chos la thugs sbyang ni mi mjad/ dad gshin re ltos skyabs gyur sprul gzugs 'dis skyo byung*/ rang nyid song tsam shi rung skyabs mgon dang bral zhing*/ gar skye gnas la rang dbang med pa zhig yin bzhin/ ro mgo ngo sprod 'debs sogs gshin po la lam ston/ rang mgo mi thon gzhan mgo bskor ba 'dis skyo byung*/ thad kar bltas pas sdig rgyal blon 'bangs dang yul 'khor/ rtag tu gnod 'tshe bsam ngan sbyong rtsub la brtson cing*/ g.yo sgyu rdzun gyis rang gzhan gnyis ka de phung nas/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa'i rgyal khams 'dis skyo byung*/ thar lam dge ba bzang po'i (196)bsam sbyor de btang nas/ phyi tshul btsun gzugs nang du tha mal pa'i spyod pa/ skya ser gnyis go chod cing chags sdang gi dregs pas/ rang phung gzhan gyi sdig rkyen byed pa 'dis skyo byung*/ mdo rgyud chos la bka' lung dbang gsum ni mi 'dug za chog cho ga klog 'don rags rim rtsam shes nas/ sgo gsum sdom pas ma bsdom rgod bag ru chas bzhin/ bsam sbyor ngan pas dad zas hab thob 'dis skyo byung*/ za 'dod sha dga' chang srid 'dod yon lngar spyod bzhin/ las su tshong dang khe spog bshas ra nyid 'grims shing*/ tshe 'di bsgrub phyir zong la dam chos nyid btsong nas/ dad pa'i skye bo'i sems sun 'byin pa 'dis skyo byung*/ ston pas tshul khrims dag cing chos nyid kyi bden mthong*/ ldan grol gnyis ldan dad zas yo byad la dbang (197)gsungs/ de dag mi ldan dkor rdzas sdug bsngal gyi 'du byed/ ngan 'gror chas bzhin dad zas spyod pa 'dis skyo byung*/ rang la dgos pa'i yon tan bslob sbyangs la mi brtson/ 'di phyir phan pa'i dge la gcig kyang ni mi sbyor/ tha mal skye bo mi dge'i khyim thabs la sbyor ba'i/ nye bar brtson pa'i btsun gzugs mdo shor 'dis skyo byung*/ 'khor ba'i bya ba gang zhen pa ni ma log

zhen bcas thar lam dge ba'i bya ba ni ma thong*/ ngag tu mi dgos mi len don med nyid sgrogs bzhin/ thabs kyis za 'dod rnyed tshol bya btang 'dis skyo byung*/ 'khor 'das bzang ngan mnyam nyid ro gcig tu ma rtogs/ gnyis snang zhen 'jin rang mtshan ma spangs par 'dug kyang*/ gnyis med rtogs par (198)rlom shing nga rgyal dang khengs pa/ ma rtogs rtogs par rlom pa'i rtogs ldan 'dis skyo byung*/ rang gis gnyis 'jin 'dre la bdud gcod ni ma thong*/ phyi ru mthong tshad 'drer snang rgyal 'gong dang dam sri/ sems khong 'khros 'khrugs bsam ngan sbyor rtsub la gcod lugs/ brtul zhugs rlom pa'i dus mtha'i gcod log 'dis skyo byung*/ thar lam byang chub don gnyer yid yul la mi 'dug gang la brten na rnyed sogs 'dir snang gi khe grags/ don du gnyer zhing mdo rgyud slob ma yi mtshan nyid/ bral ba'i bslu brid dam med slob ma 'dis skyo byung*/ dbang don rtogs pa phar zhog go myong tsam mi 'dug ༈ dbang srog 'jin pa'i dam tshig bslab bya ni ma shes/ cho ga yan lag tshang ba'i sbyang srub dang bral ba'i/ (199)rang rgyud ma smin gzhan la dbang bskur 'dis skyo byung*/ gdams khrid zab rgyas gnas la nyams myong ni mi 'dug gshar 'don lung la smin khrid ming btags zhig byed nas/ khrid brgya shi bar zhus rung sems rgyud ni tha mal/ snyan grags slob tshogs skyong ba'i bshes gnyen 'dis skyo byung*/ rtogs gom yon tan lam la sbyang bsgrod ni ma byas/ rang nyid gnyis med rtogs pa'i ngo sprod ni ma theb/ gzhan la lam ston zab mo'i ngo sprod nyid 'debs pa'i/ rang rgyud mi shes gzhan mgo bskor ba 'dis skyo byung*/ 'khrul rtog sems la gnad med thangs lhod dang grangs 'debs/ gnas dga' 'gyu sdug sems gnas gzung 'jin gyi rtod phur/ kha lta gting ma rtogs (200)pa'i yid dpyod la lhag mthong*/ gnas lugs skyang goms rlom pa'i sgom chen 'dis skyo byung*/

thugs dam pod kha mtho yang bskyed rdzogs ni mi 'dug bzlas brjod nyin mtshan 'bad rung dmigs gtad ni ma shes/ lo zlar sgrub la brtson kyang dngos grub ni ma thob/ lam gnad bral ba'i chos pa'i gzugs brnyan 'dis skyo byung*/ thugs rje mnga' bas bdag bzung sems can tsho'i srog gcod/ sdig zas sha la dgyes shing skyabs med kyi 'gro ba/ bskyed rdzogs bral ba'i dbang chog bsrung bzlog dang bsreg mnan/ 'grau don phrin las re ba'i chos 'khor 'dis skyo byung*/ bsags sbyong gnyis dang mi ldan 'gran sems kyi dbang gis/ lam la zhugs nas srog gcod rku rdzun dang g.yo thabs/ dge ba 'grib cing sgo gsum mi dge bar g.yeng ba'i/ (201)tshogs bsags mi 'gro tshogs ngan gnas skor 'dis skyo byung*/ bzang po'i yon tan can la skyon rtogs dang ngan brjod/ ngan pa'iskyon mtshangs can la gus 'dus dang zhe sa/ sems drang bden gtam smra ba mi gral du mi 'jog ngan g.yo 'khyogs la bzang lta mchog 'jin 'dis skyo byung*/ phan sems dkar por bzung na ngan g.yo la snyem za/ drang por bden gtam bshad kyang zur za ru go 'dug ci nus phan par sbyar yang phan btags ni mi go bzangalan ngan gyis 'jal ba'i skye bo 'dis skyo byung*/ sgo gsum chos mthun byas na tshul 'chos su lta zhing*/ bka' lung dri med bshad kyang yid ches ni mi 'dug zab rgyas gdams khrid btab kyang yid yul la mi 'jog rgyu 'bras blang dor bslab (202)kyang dad med 'dis skyo byung*/ chos bzhin byas na log lam bzang mdog tu 'jin cing*/ chos min spyod na rgyal khams skye bo yi yid 'ong*/ yon tan bslob sbyang byas na phrag dog dang brnyas smod/ rang skyon dang 'gal yon tan skyon lta 'dis skyo byung*/ phan pa'i dge bar bskul na skye bo gcig mi 'dud/ mi dge sdig pa bslab na rgyal khams kun der 'dud/ dam chos bdud rtsi byin kyang yid khar la mi 'ong*/

log lam bslab na phan btag yin snyam 'dis skyo byung*/ phan pa'i snying gtam smras kyang sems rgyud la mi 'jog bzang po'i yon tan bslab na sna gcig ni mi go ngan pa'i bya spyod bslab na de ma thag shes 'dug mi 'dod sna dgur slob pa'i khrel med 'dis skyo byung*/ yon tan bslab na ngan thabs slob pa dang (203)mtshungs la/ mi dge bslab na yon tan slob pa la rloms shing*/ bzang la ngan rtsi ngan pa bzang po ru rtog pa'i/ legs pa mi slob nyes pa slob pa 'dis skyo byung*/ snying nas byams skyong byas na phar phar la ring zhing*/ mi 'dod thog tu bab na tshur tshur ru nye 'ong*/ rdzun gyi mgo g.yog g.yo thabs bslu brid nyid byed pa'i/ log lam sbyor ba'i lan chags pha ma 'dis skyo byung*/ rang skyid tshe na gzhan skyid de tsam du mi 'dod/ bdag sdug che na gzhan sdug 'byung ba la dga' zhing*/ bde skyid gang yod rang nyid gcig pu la byor nas/ sdug byung kun la 'gel ba'i bsam ngan 'dis skyo byung*/ yon tan med kyang bstod na nga rgyal dang khengs sems/ rang skyon yod kyang smad na khros 'khrug nyid byed (204)cing*/ ngor bstod lkog smad khar brjod don dang ni mi mtshungs/ g.yo thabs kha zhe gnyis can blo med 'dis skyo byung*/ sangs tsam 'chi yang lo brgyar 'dug snang gi phyi tshis/ na tshod yol kyang nges 'byung skyo shas ni mi 'dug 'bad tshad don med gyur kyang da dung yang 'bad rtsol/ chags sdang rags par mngon na bzang rtsi 'dis skyo byung*/ kun gyis tshe 'di 'grub na phyi ma de rgyang 'phen/ phyi ma'i lam rgyag chos la don med du blta zhing*/ tshe rabs gtan bde sgrub 'dod yid yul la mi 'dug legs nyes 'byed mi shes pa'i blun rmongs 'dis skyo byung*/ mchog dman bar gsum kun gyi bsgrub lugs la brtags na/ gtan tu 'chi med rgas med rtag pa zhig yin nam/ mi rtag shi yang phyi mar skyid pa zhig go (205)'dug

'di phyi gnyis la bsam tshe dbang med du skyo byung*/ da ni kun gyi lus spyod tshul 'chos dang ngan g.yo/ ngag gis smras tshad rdzun dang mi mthun par 'byed tshig sems kyi bsam tshad g.yo dang gnod sems dang log lta/ thams cad bcos ma gya gyu yon po 'dis skyo byung*/ spyir gzhan la skyo ba'i tshan no/ kyai ma rang rgyud brtags na de bas chos skyo mod/ mdo rgyud chos la sbyangs kyang go yul du lus 'dug zab rgyas gdams khrid lan grangs du ma ru zhus kyang*/ rang rgyud tha mal rkyen khar dbang med du shor song*/ bcos ma'i dad pas byang chub don gnyer zhig byas nas/ mtshan ldan mkhan slob bshes dang bla ma yi drung du/ cho ga yan lag tshang ba'i sdom gsum (206)zhig 'bogs kyang*/ nyon mongs chags sdang rags shing dran shes dang bag yod/ nyams pa'i rkyen gyis na chung reg bya la chags pas/ rnam dag tshul khrims de yang dri ma can byas song*/ srid dang zhi ba'i zhing mdun ma bcab par bshags kyang*/ sdig 'phro chod pa'i spang sems brtan po ni ma byung*/ mdo rgyud chos la thos bsam dri med gcig byas kyang*/ drin can pha ma ma ma tho sdug bsngal gyi g.yengs pas/ grub mtha'i rnam dbye zhib ma mi mngon par zhi song*/ zab mo'i nyams len kha tsam yin smon la lus 'dug sngon 'gro blo ldog chos la bsam ka zhig byas kyang*/ 'di phyi 'khor ba'i chos la zhen log ni ma 'byongs/ 'khor 'das rgyu 'bras gnas rnams cung tsam zhis shes kyang*/ rgyu 'bras yid (207)chos dad pa yid yul la mi 'dug srid pa'i sdug bsngal zhib par skyo ba re bskyed kyang*/ sems rgyud 'gyur ba'i skyo shas skad cig la ma byung*/ srid las thar 'dod byang chub don gnyer re byas kyang*/ snying nas thar par 'dod pa'i nges 'byung ni mi 'dug bslu med mchog gsum ston pa lam grogs su bzung ba'i/ khas blang dam bcas skyabs 'gro kha grangs zhig bsags kyang*/

dam bca' bzhin du yang dag thar lam la zhugs pa'i/ lam nyid rjes su bsgrub pa'i skyabs 'gro ni ma 'byongs/ byams sogs tshad med bzhi la blo sbyang re byas kyang*/ snying nas nyin gcig la yang snying rje tsam ma skyes/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i sems bskyed re 'bogs kyang*/ rgyud 'gyur thub pa'i sems mchog (208)skyes pa ni ma byung*/ smon 'jug bslab bya'i gnas la blo kha re phyogs kyang*/ bka' lung mthun pa'i rgyal sras spyod pa yis dben 'dug chos kun bden med shes pa'i yid dpyod re byas kyang*/ sems la bden 'jin a 'thas ther zug na ma bri/ zab mo'i smin dbang lan grangs du ma rus kyang*/ dbang don ye shes go myong rtogs gsum gyis dben 'dug bcos min dad pas bla ma spyi bo ru bsgom nas/ mos gus gsaul 'debs bsags kyang sangs rgyas su ma mthong*/ tha mal snang zhen sbyang ba'i bskyed rim la sbyangs kyang*/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yid yul la ma gsal/ rdzogs rim bde dang gsal dang mi rtog sogs bsgom kyang*/ rlung zin 'pho ba'i rtags tsam rang rgyud la ma 'byong*/ 'khor ba ma spangs ye (209)shes rang sanang du dag pa'i/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lam gseng go yul zhig yod kyang*/ tha mal log rtog sngon goms bag chags de 'thug pas/ snang srid dag snang ma 'byongs tha mal du lus song*/ bde gshegs dgongs pa a ti snying tig la zhugs nas/ sems bral rang rig ye shes rang zhal cig mjal kyang*/ mnyam rjes gnad la gcun pa'i sbyangs shugs de chung bas/ kun rtog rlabs kyis dkrugs pas rang zhal de gab song*/ gnad gsumaldan pa'i thod rgal gseng lam la zhugs nas/ rig gdangs rdo rje lug rgyud rang zhal zhig mjal kyang*/ phyi nang rnam g.yengs dbang gis 'od gsal la ma gcun/ snang bzhi'i lam gyi rtags tshad go yul la lus song*/ bzang (210)ngan rkyen snang rtogs tshogs rang grol du dag pa'i/

thug phrad shar grol skying ba'i ngo sprod zhig theb kyang*/ graul gzhi'i ye shes ma zin 'khrul 'khyams la shor bas/ spang gnyen mtshan ma'i rtog pa chos sku ru ma songs/ bde sdug chos brgyad zhen pa'i rkyen snang la gdong 'dod/ phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad byang chud kyi grogs su/ rkyen ngan lam du slong ba'i bdud gcod la zhugs kyang*/ bdud bzhi dbyings su ma chud snyem byed la shor song*/ snang spyod sgyu mar dag pa'i dgongs spyod dang ldan na/ 'dod yon rgyan du rol pa gsang sngags kyi khyad chos/ mnyam bzhag brtan pa ma thob rjes thob kyi snang spyod/ 'dod yon lam du bslong ba'i bogs 'don ni ma nus/ 'di snang tshe 'di'i bya ba mtha' dag kun spang nas/ sngon byon dam pa'i (211)gshegs shul bsgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa/ snying nas dben pa'i ri sul bsgoms 'dod cig yod kyang*/ yul dus ngan pa'i rkyen gyis khyim thab tu lhung nges/ rang rgyud zab mo'i lam gyis smin grol la btsud nas/ nyams thag pha ma byang chub 'god 'dod cig yod kyang*/ na tshod phyed lhag yol kyang tha mal du lus 'dug gzhan don phar zhog rang mgo thon pa zhig ma byung*/ 'khor lor ldan pa'i lcang lo'i zur phud gcig bcings nas/ he ru ka pa'i chas kyis gnas yul kun nyul zhing*/ rjes shes mnyam bzhag bzla ba'i bogs 'don zhig 'dod kyang*/ lta sgom rtsal shugs ma rdzogs lus sems kyang rgud song*/ thar lam byang chub phyogs la rang nyid ni gcig pu/ (212)mi dge 'khor ba'i phyogs la thams cad kun grogs gyur/ dkar pa'i dge la bskul ba'i gros 'debs ni gcig med/ las ngan sdig la sbyor ba'i gros 'debs ni kun smra/ thar lam dge bar phyogs na lus sems kun stobs zhan/ mi dge'i las la phyogs na sgo gsum kun shugs drag phan pa'i dam chos bsgrub kyang sna 'ga' yang 'grub dka' las ngan ma bsgrub na yang rang babs kyi 'grub 'dug

rang nyid kun las lhag na phrag dog dang sma phab/ rang nyid mnyam par 'grogs na 'gran sems dang zur za/ rang nyid kun las dman na khyad gsod dang brnyas smod/ ji ltar byed kyang kun dang mthun pa zhig nam 'ong*/ gong ma ci nus bkur kyang mnyes dus ni mi 'dug bar pa mthun sbyor byas (213)kyang kheng dus ni mi 'dug 'og ma byams skyong byas kyang mgu dus ni mi 'dug gang la ci ltar byas kyang 'thad pa zhig nam 'ong*/ bde ba 'dod kyang thog tu khel dus ni 'ong dka'/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod na yang char bzhin du 'bab la/ bde skyid yod kyang mi myong da dung yang sdug yod/ gang la bsam kyang sdug bsngal kho na nyid yin med/ 'byor pa yod kyang gsog srung spel gsum gyi sdug bsngal/ med na rtag tu dbul 'phong bkren pa yi rang bzhin/ nor yod nam yang chom rkun nad sogs dang thun mong*/ nor med zas gos mi 'byor bkres skom dang sdug bsngal/ bstod kyang dga' gyi mi 'dug rang skyon gyis gang yod/ smad kyang mi dga' mi 'dug mtshang 'don du gyur (214)la/ yo byad 'byor kyang mi bzang dad gshin gyi re ltos/ bstod grags snyan pa mi bzang thar lam gyi bar chod/ rgyal khams gang du phyin kyang sdug bsngal dang 'khrug rtsod/ dben pa'i ri khrod bsdad kyang phyi nang gi g.yeng ba/ grong yul gnas kyang las nyon sdug bsngal gyi gzhan dbang*/ 'dod pa'i yul lngar gang spyod nyon mongs dang sdug snon/ gang la spyod kyang dad zas log 'tsho yi yo byad/ zas skom bzang po sbyor kyang mi gtsang snon mar/ gnas gos gang legs spyod kyang zhig ral dang 'thor brlag su dang 'grogs kyang sdig grogs mi dge bar sbyor byed/ mchog dman su dang 'phrad kyang thar lam la bar gcod/ gdos bcas lus kyis 'gro 'dug dka' tshogs dang ngal dub/ brjod tshig ngag (215)gis byed rtsol rjun tshig dang skyon brjod/ 'khrul rtogs sems kyi byung tshor chags sdang sogs chos min/

ji ltar byas kyang don med tshe 'di yi bya ba/ gang zhig bsgrub kyang las nyon sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ma/ skyes nas shi bar 'bad rung zin dus ni mi 'dug sdig sdug 'bad rtsol byas rung sogs dus ni med mod/ bu bzang go chod rloms kyang lugs gnyis ni ma 'grub/ byed byed thon thon snyam yang phyi mar ni ma phan/ shes shes go go 'dra yang blang dor ni ma shes/ ngas byas ngas thon sgrogs kyang 'di thon ni ma mthong*/ bstod grags snyan gsum 'jom yang brag cha bzhin don med/ longs spyod mnga' thang 'byor yang tha ma ni mi rtag khe dregs go sar mtho yang (216)snying po ni mi 'dug brtse brtse dung dung byang kyang shi tshe ni 'bral 'gro lo grangs rtsis grangs 'debs kyang phyir log ni mi 'ong*/ zhag dang zla ba bgrangs yang rga shi la nyer song*/ gson rung na rga 'chi sogs sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ shi rung 'khor ba'i sdug las myang 'das ni mi thob/ 'di phyi gang la bsam kyang sdug bsngal gyi brgyud mar/ zag bcas bde ba spyad kyang tshim dus ni med mdo/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal myong yang sun dus ni ma byung*/ thog med da bar 'khyams kyang thar 'dod ni mi 'dug da ni bu nga'i snying rtsa dbang med du 'dar zhing*/ sems khung chud pa'i rnam 'gyur ngo zum kun 'dus shing*/ kha skam mchi mas gdong kheb shug ring dang sngam pa/ lus sems khams kun 'dus nas dbang med du yid mug sdug (217)bsngal ngal bso tsam la bde ba ru rloms nas/ log 'tsho yo byad 'byor pas dga' bde yi rnam 'gyur/ bzhin dwangs rgod bag mchong rgyug glu gar dang rtsed mjo/ kha rgyal rtsod dang ha bgad yid khar la ma byung*/ sngon tshe grangs med 'das pa'i rgyal ba dang sras bcas/ shul du lus shing 'dren thabs bral ba de rang nyes/ da rung 'di bzhin sgrub na yang yang du 'khor zhing*/ ma 'ong skyabs gnas rnams kyis snga ma la bzhin lhag 'gro thar pa'i thabs ni bstan pa dam chos nyid yin na/

rang gis zhi ba'i go 'phang sgrub pa la brtson las/ gzhanya gyis stobs kyis zhi bar 'dren pa ni mi srid/ srid na sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyis drang mod/ rang gis rtag tu kun 'byung (218)las nyon mongs la brtson bzhin/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal dbang med myong nges zhig bsgrub nas/ nam zhig shi tshe bya khu bskrod pa bzhin bla mas/ dag pa'i zhing ngam thar pa 'dren 'dod ni log lta/ lhar bcas 'jig rten khams na sdug bsngal gyi gnas las/ skyabs dang skyobs pa mchog gsum bslu med las su yod/ bu ngas dad pas kun bslang gdung shugs de phyung nas/ smre ngag gdung ba'i ros thugs dam nyid bskul lo/ khyad par rang la skye ba'i tshan no/ ༈ kye ma kye hud bslu med mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum/ khyed la 'gro ba skyobs pa'i yon tan dang mthu nus/ bsam mi khyab cing sngon tshe 'gro ba yi don du/ bla med thugs bskyed mjad pa'i yi dam de dgongs sam/ bdag tu mjad pa'i pha (219)ma 'gro khams kyi tshogs la/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan phrin las rnams shugs phyung*/ ma g.yel da lta myur du sdug bsngal las sgrol la/ 'bras bu'i mthar thug byang chub chen po la bkod thong*/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs sras bcas sogs skyabs gnas/ kun gyi mkhyen brtse yon tan phrin las dang nus pa/ 'phro dang 'du ba'i byed po drin chen gyi bla ma/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rtag khyab lhun grub kyi bdag nyid/ khyod ni ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam rol nyid yin pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mi zad pa'i 'khor los/ gang la gang 'dul gdul bya mchog dman dang bstun la/ dus las mi yol phrin las nus mthu de phyung shog sngon tshe bde (220)gshegs ston pa dag pa yi gdul byar/ snang bas chos kyi 'khor lo rang 'bras la bkod nas/ dus mtha'i nyams thag 'gro rnams phyi shul du lus pa/ sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa khyod nyid la bcol med/

dus mthar skyes pa'i ma dag gdul bya la dgongs nas/ thugs kyi ma bzod bsam bzhin mi gzigs su sprul nas/ 'gro rgyud khams dang bstun nas smin grol la bkod nas/ 'brel tshad srid zhi'i bder 'god khyod nyid kyi khyad chos/ bdag sogs mkha' khyab sems can sdug bsngal gyi mnar bzhin/ dbang med las dang nyon mongs rgya mtsho ru bying ba/ 'di tsam zhig na srid las thar pa ni ma nges/ 'di las lhag pa'i nyams thag mgon khyod kyi gar gzigs/ 'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal (221)gnas la 'jig pa yi gdung na/ bdag cag re ltos 'cha' pa khyed nyid las su btsal/ khyed kyang bdag sogs 'gro la phan bde nyid sgrub las/ rang gi don du bya ba sgrub rgyu ni med mdo/ sngon nas nyams thag 'gro la mtha' gcig tu phan 'dod/ thugs bskyed mjad pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du mjad na/ sngon gyi yi dam mjad pa'i dam bca' de dgongs la/ gang 'dul mjad pa'i phrin las ma g.yel bar mjod cig khyod ni chos kun dbang 'byor rnam pa nyid thams cad/ mkhyen brtse yon tan phrin las nus mthu la dbang bas/ bdag tu mjad pa'i nyams thag bu rgyud kyi tshogs la/ pha yi thugs rje brtse bas byang chub la bkod thong*/ bdag ni (222)las nyon dbang gis da bar du 'khor tshe/ sha khrag rus dang ngus pa'i mchi ma de bsags na/ ri dang rgya mtsho las lhag de tsam zhig myong bzhin/ skyabs mgon bral ba de'i tshe mgon khyod ni gar bzhugs/ srid zhir mi gnas myang 'das chen po ru bzhugs tshe/ sangs rgyas khyod ni rtag khyab lhun grub kyi bdag nyid/ phyogs ris bral zhing chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen brtse/ phrin las nus mthu bcas pas da bar du gang mjad/ 'on kyang rtag tu 'bral med rang mdun du bzhugs kyang*/ las snang log pas zhal ras ma mjal ba yin nam/ bdag gi bsod nams dge dang 'gro mgon gyi smon lam/ rten 'brel dag pa'i dbang gis mngon sum du zhal mjal/

de yang las smon rag (223)las gzhan dbang zhig yin na/ mgon khyod dbang bcu mnga' zhing chos kun la dbang 'byor/ lhun grub phrin las bcas pa gzhan dbang du gyur mdo/ bdag gi las snang dag tshe mgon khyod kyang ma dgos/ rang gis tshogs gnyis lam sbyangs 'bras bu nyid thob pa/ bdag mthus yin na mgon po khyed nyid kyis ci mjad/ 'di ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi dgongs yul la mnga' mdo/ bdag gis bsam mi khyab na gsal po ru ston cig bdag la nam yang thar pa'i ston pa po mgon khyod/ nyid kyi mngon byas lam de bdag nyid la bstan pas/ ngas kyang tshul bzhin sgrub na rdzogs byang nyid thob nges/ 'di ltar bsam gyin mgon po'i stobs nyid du nges so/ stobs bcu (224)mnga' ba'i rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams bdag gis/ chu bur mig gis ma mthong dad mas kyi yul tsam/ mgon khyod skyabs kun cig char 'dus pa nyid mngon sum/ yin par thag chod da ni gzhan la ni mi ltos/ nam zhig bdag gis 'phags pa'i ye shes nyid rtogs nas/ rang gzhan don sgrub nus tshe thugs chung ni mi dgos/ da lta so skyes las nyon sug bsngal gyis gzer zhing*/ srid zhi'i rgud pas byed thabs bral tshe 'dir gzigs shig tha mal pha mas bu rgyud byams sems kyis skyong bzhin/ sdug bsngal nyi tshe skyobs cing bde ba la sbyor na/ bdag nyid chen pos bu la rtag pa ru gzigs nas/ sdug bsngal las bskyab bde bar 'god pa ni rigs mdo/ 'phags pa'i ye shes bral ba'i 'jig (225)rten gyi dregs pa/ ma rung brten rung gnas skabs bde ba la btson na/ chos kyi rgyal po stobs bcu mnga' ba yis bu la/ thugs rjes gzung nas nam yang phan bde la los 'god/ rtog pa med pa'i nor bu rin chen dang bum pa/ gsol ba btab na srid pa'i dgos 'dod nyid rtsol na/ srid zhi'i phun tshogs bla ma sangs rgyas nyid rin chen/ bu yi ji ltar 'dod pa'i re ba nyid sgong mjod/

da lta snyigs ma bod zhing sdug bsngal gyis gdung tshe/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal pa 'gro mgon gyi bla mas/ rmad byung rdo rje snying po'i zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor/ phyir mi ldog pa da lta myur ba nyid bskor mjod/ dpa' bo khyod ni skal bzang 'gro rnams kyi spyi mthun/ (226)bsod nams gcig tu bsdom pa'i las snang gi mthu dang*/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i mchog gsum rtsa gsum gyi ye shes/ thugs rje nus kun bsdom pa'i bdag nyid can yin na/ srid dang zhi ba'i gnas na khyodanyid las che btsan/ yon tan phrin las 'gran zla mtshungs pa ni mi srid/ de dang mtshungs pa'i mthu rtsal thugs rje nyid phyung la/ 'gro khams rgya mtsho'i 'khor ba dong sprugs nyid mjod cig dgongs shig dgongs shig mkhyen brtse nus pa yis dgongs cig ma g.yel ma g.yel thugs rje byin brlabs nyid ma g.yel/ ma 'chugs ma 'chugs gang 'dul mjad pa ni ma 'chugs/ mjod cig mjod cig phrin las smin grol nyid mjod cig da ni sdug bsngal mchi ma mgon po yis (227)sol la/ bdag gi spyi bor mtshan ldan phyag gis ni nyug bzhin/ mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag rgyud smin grol du tshud la/ dbugs dbyung gzing bstod nam zhig byang chub nyid lung ston/ skyo ba'i shugs kyis skyabs 'tshol zhing mgon po bskul 'debs kyi tshan no/ ༈ e ma/ bu khyod sems kyi skyo ba de tsam zhig mi dgos/ zhum pa sol la spro dga' yang yang du bskyed dang*/ de tsam sdug pa min te skye mtha' la skyid pa'i/ nyi ma 'char nges rang gzhan don sgrub kyang nus 'ong*/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun las lhag pa yi ston pas/ rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i mdo sngags bstan pa yi lhag zhabs/ mjal bas bdag gi byang chub don gnyer gyi (228)'dun pa/ ci nus bskyed la zhugs dang zum pa ni ci dgos/ srid zhi'i yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas kyi sems mchog bla na med pa bskyed la rgyal sras kyi spyod par/

rang stobs nus pas blo kha de nyid la phyogs dang*/ bde nas bde bar 'gro 'ong zhum pa ni ci dgos/ rgyal sras spyod pa'i tshe na ngang thung ni mi 'os/ srid pa ci srid de srid 'khor ba 'dir gnas nas/ kun bzang 'jam dpal spyod bzhin rdzogs smin dang sbyang la/ smon pa'i go cha gyon dang zhum pa ni ci dgos/ snang 'di gdod nas ma skyes spros pa dang bral zhing*/ srid zhi mnyam nyid zab mo stong nyid kyi bye brag dgag sgrub spang blang bral ba nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i/ chos nyid don la som dang zhum pa ni ci dgos/ stong nyid rang mdangs rten (229)'brel sgyu ma yi rnam pa'i/ 'khor 'das chos kun med snang stong gzugs kyi bye brag snang mnyam blang dor chos med thams cad kun dag pa/ de ltar sems dang bu khyod zhum pa ni ci dgos/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa thun min gyi lam gang*/ smin grol zab rgyas gnas la gus pa dang bcas pas/ thos bsam lhur long zab mo'i lam gseng gi phyogs la/ bag chags bzang por zhog dang zhum pa ni ci dgos/ 'di ltar snang ba'i 'khor 'das chos rnams kyi rang bzhin/ sems nyid rig stong rjen pa bde chen gyi rang snang*/ thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas skyon yon kun mnyam pas/ dgongs spyod kun bzang sbyor dang zhum pa ni ci dgos/ rgyal ba (230)kun las thugs rje phrin las nyid lhag pa'i/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po drin chen gyi bla ma/ thugs brtses bzung nas rnam dag smon lam nyid btab na/ de'i mthus nam yang bde 'ong zhum pa na ci dgos/ 'gro mgon de'i dgongs bcud rdo rje yi snying po'i/ smin grol gnas rnams bdag nyid dad pa yi gzhi la/ yang yang 'dom pa'i skal bzang slob ma nyid gyur pas/ bdag kyang de'i rjes slob dang zhum pa ni ci dgos/ khyad par sngags 'di bka' btsan byin rlabs nyid che la/ de ston rdo rje slob dpon de bas kyang byin che/ der bzhugs rdo rje'i mchod kyang mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig

skye 'chi bar dor skyid 'ong zhum pa ni ci dgos/ ston pas ji ltar bstan pa bslu ba ni mi srid/ dam chos (231)mdo rgyud bslu ba med pa ni mi srid/ der slob dge 'dun rig 'jin bslu ba ni mi srid/ der bsgrub srid zhi'i bder 'byung bslu ba ni mi srid/ der phyir bu khyod bka' bzhin yang yang du sgrub la/ phyi nang g.yeng ba spangs shing lus ngag gi dge ba/ don chung tshogs che lung ma bstan nyid dang 'dres pa'i/ bya ba thong la sems kyi dam chos nyid byos shig bdag gis bdag nyid yang dag byang chub la 'god pa'i/ slob dpon bdag nyid slob ma bdag nyid du gyis dang*/ 'di las lhag pa'i bla slob srid pa na mi srid/ 'di las lhag pa'i gdams ngag gang gis kyang mi ston/ bdag la bdag las bag nyal shes pa ni dka' mdo/ bdag la bdag las yag dga' nyes sdug zhig sus byed/ (232)bdag la bdag las sha tsha'i gros 'debs zhig sus smra/ bdag la bdag las srid zhi'i phan bde nyid sus sgrubs/ bdag la bdag las phan btson gnyen gshes shig gar 'ong*/ bdag la bdag las bu gcig sdug pa ni gar yod/ bdag la bdag las byams skyong rtag pa cig sus byed/ bdag la bdag las phyi mtha' 'tsho rgyu ni mi lon/ bdag gis bdag nyid ma 'dul gzhan gyis ni mi 'dul/ bdag gis bdag nyid ma smin gzhan gyis ni smin dka'/ bdag gis bdag nyid ma grol gzhan gyis ni mi dkrol/ bdag gis bdag nyid lam zhog gzhan gyis ni mi zhog de bas bu khyod snying la 'jub mo nyid tshug la/ yang nas yang du sgo gsum bka' lung dang bstun cig mtshan ldan bla ma'i (233)thugs dgongs rdzogs pa gcig 'bad 'tshal/ de ltar byed na a bu 'di phyi kun skyid 'ong*/ de ltar byed na bstan pa'i zhabs phyi yang des yong*/ de ltar byed na pha ma'i drin lan yang des gzo/ de ltar byed na 'brel tshad don ldan zhig des thub/ de ltar byed na rang gzhan don gnyis ni 'grub nges/

bden gtam zang mar smras pa'i legs bshad kyi gtam 'di/ mthong thos dran dang reg dang yid nyid la byed dang*/ bdag la re ltos 'cha' ba'i yon sbyor dang 'khor slob/ 'gro khams mtha' yas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig thub pas bsngags pa'i dben pa'i yon tan kun tshang ba'i/ nags tshal mjes pas brgyan pa'i mi med kyi ri sul/ khrom gyi rdzong (234)nag 'od gsal byang chub kyi phug gang*/ sgyu ma'i yul na sgyu ma'i cho rol la spyod cing*/ log rtog sgyu ma'i rang gzugs dbang med du gyur pa'i/ sgyu ma'i 'gro ngan dam pa'i mdo shor pa khrel med/ bstan pa'i bla btsang khyi rgan smyo shul pa skyo nas/ dbang med shugs kyis bden gtam drang por rang bris so/ rten dang brten pa'i snod bcud stong nyid kyi rang gzugs/ 'gyur khug ldan pa'i drang srong skyo glu dang stong sgra/ sems kyi byung tshor rtog pa rang mal du sangs nas/ nang dbyings chos sku'i bla ma'i zhal mjal la pheb song*/ zhum pa'i le lo sel phyir spro dga' bskyed pa'i gros 'debs kyi tshan rdzogs so/ dge'o/ (235)na mo gu ru ye/ brgyud ldan bla ma'i thugs kyis bskyang ba'i/ nags su nyal ba'i bag yangs rgan po/ chos sems can gyi ka srol nyan na/ chos dang chos min shan thang shes 'ong*/ srid pa'i gnas la skyo shas tshad med/ zhi bar 'dod pa'i nges 'byung drag po/ ma rgan 'gro la snying rje'i shugs kyis/ drang ba'i sems bskyed chos kyi gzhi ma/ skyabs kun 'dus zhal bla ma sangs rgyas/ bsags sbyong zhing mchog bsgom sgrub snying po/ khyed shes mos gus dad pas gsol 'debs/ rtag tu byed pa gcig chog rgyal po dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig dag pas/ 'khor 'das dag mnyam dag snang phyogs med/ snang srid rnam dag dkyil (236)'khor gsum du/ yang yang sbyang pa gsang chen nyams len/ 'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog thad kar chod pa'i/ gnyug ma'i ye shes zang thal rjen pa/

shes nyams yid dpyod blo yis ma thug brjod bral gshis 'di lta ba'i mthar thug ma bsgom ma bzung blo yis dam bcos/ rtog bral rig pa rang mal gnas pa/ btang bzhag bral ba'i gnyug ma'i dran pa/ mi yengs mi bsgom rang gnas sgom pa/ zang thal rig pa'i ye shes kha yan/ dgongs pa'i klong du 'khor 'das rtog tshogs/ ci tsam shar yang rang sar dag na/ tshogs drug rang grol ro mnyam spyod pa/ bzang ngan kun rtog dbyings su yar ba'i/ ka dag ye shes chos sku'i ngo bo/ gzhi snang rnam dag gzugs sku'i rang bzhin/ zung (237)'jug 'bras bu rang chas lhun grub/ blos byas lta sgom sems rtog 'dus byas/ blo bral ye shes lta sgom cig chod/ rim dgu'i rtse mo rdo rje snying po'i/ dgongs pa'i zab gnad de tsam 'du skad/ sems bral rig pa'i ye shes goms na/ ma rig bdag 'jin nyon mongs rang zhig rang rtsal mkhyen rtse yon tan gong 'phel/ lam gnad ma 'chug bsgom pa'i rtag tshad/ rang gshis ngan pa'i chos brgyad zhen chags/ zhig nas gong ma'i rjes su snyogs na/ sgrub pa'i 'bras bu phyi dus ma dgos/ ji ltar gnas rung rnal 'byor mchog go yang dag lam gyi rten 'brel thams cad/ mtshan ldan bla ma tshul bzhin brten nas/ mdo rgyud zab rgyas man ngag (238)sems rgyud sbyar ba kho nar 'du'o/ phan bzhed rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snying po/ mdo rgyud nyams len zab rgyas gnad kun/ ma nor ma 'chug yang dag der 'du/ rig 'jin bla mas dge legs rtsol 'os/ de las gzhan gyur snyigs ma'i chos gzugs/ dam pa ma brten mdo rgyud chos la/ thos bsam med pas lam gnad ma shes/ gzugs brnyan bsgrub nas snying rus byed skad/ dad dang nges 'byung snying rje sems mchog mos gus dam tshig dag snang gso sbyong*/ gang yang med pa'i rang gshis gyong por/ gnas lugs sgom zer kha pho smra ste/ don la gnad med sems rtog sdug btsir/ gnas 'gyur rig gsum bar lag sbrel nas/

shes pa'i gsal nyams (239)ro myong zhen pa/ lta bar rloms te mngon pa'i nga rgyal/ ngas rtogs 'di yin nges shes yod ring*/ gnyis med don gyi dgongs pa ma yin/ spangs blang dgag sgrub zhen pa yod ring*/ mtha' bral rtogs pa'i gnas lugs ma yin/ yengs kyi dgos pa'i dran pa'i 'jin stong*/ ci tsam gom yang sems gnas tsam las/ spangs rtogs yon tan sna gcig med na/ shi bar bsgom rung 'khrul snang zang ma/ lus sems bcos shing lta stang zim bus/ shes nyams rtogs rloms gya gyu skyongs dang*/ bsgom pas bsdus nas rkyen dang 'phrad tshe/ rang gshis mtshang ston nga 'dra 'ong nges/ don med stong 'ding 'khrul 'byams kho nas/ bsnyen bsgrub bzlas brjod rnam (240)grangs mang zhing*/ gsol mchod re smon tshe 'dir gtad pa'i/ chos gzugs dred po rang rtsid che 'ong*/ mi shes blalun pos dad gshin re ltos/ khur du blangs pa'i rnyed bstod tshe 'dir/ sgrub pa'i chos pa rang gzhan mgo bskor/ bslu byed mkhan la rgyal ba mi dgyes/ don la mdo rgyud chos kyi zab gnad/ gang yang med pa'i sgrub pa lo zla'i/ kha grangs brtsi yang rang gshis sngar las/ chos mthun yon tan gang yang med na/ chos sa grags tsam don 'bras chung go ltar snang chos sgrub mtshan ma'i rnam g.yeng*/ 'bras bu ngan song chos ltar bcos pa'i/ log lam mang yang 'di tsam kho na/ shes nas rang rgyud zhu dag mjod kyi/ gzhan skyon rtog pa'i zur za ma yin/ (241)(242)rang mtshang ngas bzung chos min bsam spyod/ ngal ba 'bras med chos sems can tshos/ tshul bzhin spang na rang drin che'o/ za nyal rnam g.yengs ri la bzung nas/ snyoms las blo bde dal khoms nyol dang*/ skye 'chi bar do nyams nga'i 'jigs pa/ ci bya stor med myur du 'ong nges/ kye ma kye hud de'i tshe ci byed/ byed tshe yod tshe myur bar myur bar/ 'chi kha phan pa'i lha chos rnam dag sems rgyud 'gyur ba'i dge sbyor brtson ran/
bdag dang bdag 'dra'i chos gzugs tha mal/ bsam spyod can la brgyud gsum bla mas/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu rtsal phyung la/ sems rgyud chos dang 'dres par mjod cig
dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ rin chen tshe ring*/ bla ma rdo lu/ rje bla ma las so/
